'''Jon Tomayko''' (also published as '''Jon Tomako''')<ref name="dt-4730">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4730 Court of the Vile Scum], DeckTech (Jon "Bravo10" Tomayko, 27 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4730/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4730/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018191433/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4730/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Bravo10''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list on DeckTech in March 2000. He was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed (as Jon Tomako) as Bravo 10 from Knoxville, Tn., matching his DeckTech handle; the slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
